川西 (1).jpg.zh: 绿坡起伏，草甸受光，灰岩尖峰立于积云之下
川西 (1).jpg.en: Rolling green meadows, sunlit ridges, and a jagged grey peak beneath cumulus clouds.

川西 (2).jpg.zh: 云层下灰色岩峰拔起于起伏的绿色草甸之上
川西 (2).jpg.en: Grey rocky peaks rise above rolling green meadows beneath a cloud-streaked sky.

川西 (3).jpg.zh: 暖色晨光穿过浓雾，照亮林间小屋与树影
川西 (3).jpg.en: Warm morning light filters through thick fog, lighting a small hut and trees.

川西 (4).jpg.zh: 朽木裂纹间簇生翠绿苔藓，一颗水珠悬在虚化的绿意前
川西 (4).jpg.en: Bright green moss clusters sprout from cracked weathered wood, a single droplet against blurred green

川西 (5).jpg.zh: 浓雾中的棕白花牛立于开满黄色野花的草甸
川西 (5).jpg.en: A brown-and-white cow stands in a foggy meadow dotted with yellow wildflowers.

川西 (6).jpg.zh: 黑牦牛立于带孔石墙前，远处是高原城镇与积云晴空
川西 (6).jpg.en: A black yak stands by a holed stone wall, distant plateau town under cloudy blue sky.

川西 (7).jpg.zh: 仰拍：五彩经幡从木杆向蓝天四散，云隙透出明亮日光
川西 (7).jpg.en: Low-angle view of colorful prayer flags streaming from a pole against a cloud-streaked blue sky.

川西.jpg.zh: 长曝光下，溪水从苔藓岩壁滑落，秋叶点缀两侧。
川西.jpg.en: Long exposure: a stream slips down mossy rocks, autumn leaves framing both sides.

大连 (1).jpg.zh: 夕阳穿过玻璃幕墙，电车线网交织的街头车流
大连 (1).jpg.en: Sunset light between glass towers, tram wires crisscrossing over traffic-filled streets.

大连 (2).jpg.zh: 夜色中密集的高层住宅群，街灯把弯曲道路染成橙黄。
大连 (2).jpg.en: High-rise apartments at night, a curving avenue glowing orange under streetlights.

大连 (3).jpg.zh: 晴日海畔，金色芦苇丛与岩顶覆枯草的礁石
大连 (3).jpg.en: Golden reeds and a grass-topped rock outcrop by the sea under a clear sky

大连 (4).jpg.zh: 晴空下四只海鸥展翅掠过，白羽被强烈阳光照得发亮
大连 (4).jpg.en: Four seagulls glide across a clear blue sky, wings bright in strong sunlight

大连 (5).jpg.zh: 褐色层岩柱矗立碎冰湖面，远处蓝水带横贯天际
大连 (5).jpg.en: A layered brown rock pillar stands amid cracked lake ice, open blue water beyond.

大连 (6).jpg.zh: 橙蓝渐变的天幕下，海鸥剪影掠过城市天际线与水面
大连 (6).jpg.en: Seagulls in silhouette glide over the city skyline against a dusk gradient sky

大连 (7).jpg.zh: 暮色中开阔广场行人稀疏，远处双塔高楼映着粉橙天空
大连 (7).jpg.en: At dusk, sparse pedestrians cross a wide plaza before twin towers under a pink-orange sky.

大连 (8).JPG.zh: 逆光下的玻璃幕墙高楼与公交车，大连街头黄昏
大连 (8).JPG.en: Backlit glass towers and a bus on a Dalian street at dusk

大连 (9).JPG.zh: 枯树林前的干土地上，暖阳斜照，一头长角公鹿正对镜头站立。
大连 (9).JPG.en: On dry ground before bare winter trees, a antlered stag stands facing the camera in warm sunlight.

大连.BMP.zh: 舷窗外，客机机翼与橙红翼尖小翼横在无云的蓝天上
大连.BMP.en: Through the cabin window, the wing and its orange winglet cut across a cloudless blue sky.

大连.jpg.zh: 夕阳把海湾染成橙红，长桥与楼群化作剪影，海鸥掠过天际
大连.jpg.en: Sunset turns the bay orange; a long bridge and skyline silhouette as gulls cross the sky.

稻城亚丁 (1).jpg.zh: 雪山崖壁下，金顶喇嘛庙半掩于松林，云雾缠绕峰顶
稻城亚丁 (1).jpg.en: A golden-roofed monastery hidden among pines beneath snow peaks, clouds drifting over the summits.

稻城亚丁 (2).jpg.zh: 柔光透过绿叶，一只棕颊斑纹小鸟立于枯枝，背景虚化
稻城亚丁 (2).jpg.en: A rufous-cheeked, barred bird perches on a bare branch, soft light filtering through blurred green foliage.

稻城亚丁 (3).jpg.zh: 红嘴山鸦立于木桩，身后是虚化的高原草甸与层叠青山
稻城亚丁 (3).jpg.en: A red-billed chough perches on a wooden post against blurred green highland meadows.

稻城亚丁 (4).jpg.zh: 深色层岩与残雪交错，峰顶切过积云的蓝天。
稻城亚丁 (4).jpg.en: Dark stratified rock and patchy snow cut against a cloud-streaked blue sky.

稻城亚丁.jpg.zh: 阴天柔光，慢门瀑布沿深色岩壁垂落，针叶横枝框住水幕
稻城亚丁.jpg.en: Overcast soft light: a long-exposure waterfall slips down dark rock as green conifer branches frame the stream.

哈尔滨 (2).jpg.zh: 粉墙白拱的礼拜堂内，彩窗与金饰天使映着暖光
哈尔滨 (2).jpg.en: Pink walls and white arches frame stained glass and gilded angels in a chapel.

哈尔滨.jpg.zh: 蓝天白云下，红砖教堂的绿色洋葱顶与金色十字架高耸
哈尔滨.jpg.en: Green onion domes and gold crosses rise above the red-brick church under a blue sky

哈尔滨圣索菲亚教堂.jpg.zh: 蓝色穹顶下，金色吊灯悬垂，漆面剥落露出斑驳灰泥
哈尔滨圣索菲亚教堂.jpg.en: A gilded chandelier hangs from a peeling blue vaulted ceiling, paint flaking to bare plaster.

杭州 (1).jpg.zh: 逆光下青枫枝叶低垂，背景虚化成石径与光斑
杭州 (1).jpg.en: Backlit green maple leaves hang over a blurred stone path.

杭州 (2).jpg.zh: 正午阳光下，两朵粉荷挺立于密接的绿叶间，旁有花苞待放
杭州 (2).jpg.en: Under the midday sun, two pink lotus blooms rise above dense green leaves beside a bud

花果山 (1).jpg.zh: 晴空下覆雪冷杉高耸，两名游客立于树前仰望。
花果山 (1).jpg.en: Under a clear blue sky, two visitors stand before a towering snow-covered spruce.

花果山 (2).jpg.zh: 晴空下松枝缀满雾凇，侧逆光里冰晶泛白，冬日的冷蓝与霜白相接
花果山 (2).jpg.en: Rime-coated pine branches glow white against a clear blue winter sky

花果山.jpg.zh: 晨光斜照，雾凇包裹的松枝在蓝天下泛出淡粉光泽
花果山.jpg.en: Morning light tints frost-covered pine needles pink against a clear blue sky

九寨沟 (2).jpg.zh: 雪后初晴，枯枝与沉木静卧在碧蓝的湖水中
九寨沟 (2).jpg.en: After snowfall, bare branches and sunken logs rest in the turquoise lake.

九寨沟 (3).jpg.zh: 逆光下红枫与嫩绿枝叶交叠，林间散景斑驳
九寨沟 (3).jpg.en: Backlit red maple leaves against soft green foliage, dappled forest bokeh

九寨沟 (4).jpg.zh: 石板窄巷，白墙黑迹，六角窗前黄衣人独行
九寨沟 (4).jpg.en: A lone walker in yellow passes hexagonal windows along a stone-paved alley of weathered white walls.

九寨沟 (5).jpg.zh: 阴天，江南水乡的白墙黛瓦与黄绿大树倒映在平静河面
九寨沟 (5).jpg.en: White-walled Jiangnan water town mirrored in still water beneath a yellow-green tree under overcast sky.

九寨沟 (6).jpg.zh: 夜色下的金鸡湖畔，东方之门通体亮灯，游艇静泊于栈桥前
九寨沟 (6).jpg.en: Night falls over Jinji Lake as the arched Gate of the Orient glows above moored yachts.

九寨沟 (7).jpg.zh: 斜阳下，橘白猫伏在编织席上闭目打盹
九寨沟 (7).jpg.en: An orange-and-white cat dozes on a woven mat in soft sunlight

九寨沟.jpg.zh: 木栏杆外，蓝绿渐变的湖水清澈见底，红色救生圈倚在岸边
九寨沟.jpg.en: Beyond the wooden railing, clear turquoise lake water reveals the bottom, a red lifebuoy resting nearby

喀纳斯 (1).jpg.zh: 左岸红色漂流艇与乳蓝色冰川河，两岸松林在阴云下延伸
喀纳斯 (1).jpg.en: Turquoise glacial river with red rafts, pine forest lining both banks under overcast sky

喀纳斯 (2).jpg.zh: 暮色里针叶林环抱的高山湖泊，薄雾漫过草甸与远山
喀纳斯 (2).jpg.en: A misty alpine lake ringed by conifers, meadows fading into foggy hills at dusk

连岛.jpg.zh: 退潮后的沙滩上浅水映着天光，几台黄色作业车停在水中央
连岛.jpg.en: At low tide, yellow work vehicles rest in the shallow water of a wide flat beach.

七彩丹霞.jpg.zh: 澄澈蓝天里，彩色格纹热气球喷着火焰缓缓升空
七彩丹霞.jpg.en: A colorful checkered hot air balloon fires its burner against a clear blue sky

青岛 (1).jpg.zh: 暮色海面上，橙红落日悬于薄雾中，一艘客轮缓缓驶过。
青岛 (1).jpg.en: A ferry glides across a hazy sea as the orange sun sets.

青岛 (2).jpg.zh: 孔雀蓝颈羽特写，身侧是手写黑板与木质货架
青岛 (2).jpg.en: Close-up of a peacock's blue neck beside a handwritten chalkboard and wooden shelves

青岛 (3).jpg.zh: 亭桥横跨湖面，绿树与远山倒映水中，晴空浮着薄云
青岛 (3).jpg.en: A pavilion bridge spans the lake; trees and hills mirror in the calm water under a clear sky

青岛 (4).jpg.zh: 阴天灰白天空下，文庙深色木构飞檐与金字匾额，檐下红灯一角。
青岛 (4).jpg.en: Overcast white sky above dark wooden eaves and a gilded Confucian temple plaque, red lantern below.

青岛 (5).jpg.zh: 阴天散光下，木构戏台蓝绿彩绘斗拱，圆窗棂格映深木门扇
青岛 (5).jpg.en: Under overcast light, a wooden opera stage with blue-green painted brackets and a round lattice window

青岛 (6).jpg.zh: 五四广场夜色中，红色雕塑与霓虹高楼隔水相映，游人驻足拍照
青岛 (6).jpg.en: At night in May Fourth Square, a red sculpture faces neon towers across the water as visitors photograph.

青岛.jpg.zh: 蓝调时刻，红白灯塔立于防波堤尽头，天际晕开一抹淡紫。
青岛.jpg.en: Blue hour: a red-and-white lighthouse at the breakwater's end, a faint violet band on the horizon.

青海.jpg.zh: 苍茫戈壁滩上，风机静立，远处荒山隐入灰白薄雾
青海.jpg.en: Wind turbines stand on a vast desert plain, distant ridges fading into pale haze.

青海湖 (1).jpg.zh: 晴空薄云下，金顶藏式白塔，白色基座嵌蓝色狮面浮雕
青海湖 (1).jpg.en: Golden-spired white stupa with blue lion reliefs on its base under a cloudy sky.

青海湖 (2).jpg.zh: 成群海鸥栖在滩涂上，白色游船泊于碧蓝水面，云层低垂
青海湖 (2).jpg.en: Gulls line the marshy shore as white cruise boats moor in turquoise water beneath a cloud-streaked sky.

四姑娘山 (1).jpg.zh: 晴空卷云下，积雪覆盖的峰脊与深色针叶林形成明暗对峙
四姑娘山 (1).jpg.en: Under a cirrus sky, snow-veined ridges rise above dark conifer slopes.

四姑娘山 (2).jpg.zh: 徒步者散落在棕色高山草坡上，远处雪峰夹峙谷地
四姑娘山 (2).jpg.en: Hikers scattered across a brown alpine slope, snow peaks framing the valley ahead.

四姑娘山.jpg.zh: 冷杉剪影间，双峰积雪在晴空下显出岩脊纹理
四姑娘山.jpg.en: Snow-streaked twin peaks rise between dark firs under a clear blue sky.

武汉.jpg.zh: 红色韶山9型机车牵引绿皮车厢，驶过接触网下的碎石轨道
武汉.jpg.en: A red Shaoshan 9 locomotive hauls green carriages along gravel tracks beneath catenary wires.

新疆 (1).jpg.zh: 暮色蓝调，满月悬于云层，红砖烟囱立于居民楼群之上
新疆 (1).jpg.en: Blue-hour sky with a full moon and a lone red brick chimney above apartment blocks

新疆 (1).png.zh: 沙丘上的木质观景塔倒映在粉红浅水中，云层低垂
新疆 (1).png.en: A wooden viewing tower reflects in pink shallows beneath low storm clouds.

新疆 (2).jpg.zh: 夕照下辫状河穿过杨树林与草坡，岸旁停着几辆车
新疆 (2).jpg.en: At sunset, a braided river winds past cottonwood groves and grassy slopes where cars are parked.

新疆 (3).jpg.zh: 暮色紫红云层下，居民楼与信号塔剪影浮现在天际
新疆 (3).jpg.en: Crimson clouds drift over silhouetted apartment blocks and a telecom tower at dusk.

新疆 (4).jpg.zh: 针叶林山坡下，牛群在午后草甸上吃草，云影掠过山脊
新疆 (4).jpg.en: Cattle graze on a green meadow below dense conifer slopes under a cloud-streaked sky.

新疆 (5).jpg.zh: 阴天山路上，背包客沿弯道走向层叠远山
新疆 (5).jpg.en: A lone backpacker walks a curving mountain road toward layered peaks under overcast skies.

新疆 (6).jpg.zh: 干旱峡谷间辫状河道蜿蜒，层岩崖壁裸露在蓝天白云下。
新疆 (6).jpg.en: A braided river winds through a dry layered canyon under blue sky and clouds.

新疆.jpg.zh: 阳光穿过树枝，浅溪卵石间的水面泛起光斑
新疆.jpg.en: Sunlight through branches, glints on shallow water among stream pebbles

新疆赛里木湖 (1).jpg.zh: 晴空下，红衣女子沿石堤走过红白灯塔，身后是蓝湖与远山
新疆赛里木湖 (1).jpg.en: Under clear skies, a woman in red walks past a red-and-white beacon beside the blue lake and mountains

新疆赛里木湖 (2).jpg.zh: 浅水倒映云影，绿草甸接金黄草场，雪山横亘天际
新疆赛里木湖 (2).jpg.en: Shallow water mirrors clouds; green marsh grass meets golden meadow below snow peaks.

新疆赛里木湖 (4).jpg.zh: 深蓝湖面延展至天际，远处山脉横陈，右侧积云堆叠
新疆赛里木湖 (4).jpg.en: Deep blue water stretches to the horizon, distant mountains beneath a sky stacked with cumulus clouds.

新疆赛里木湖 (6).jpg.zh: 高原湖岸公路沿金黄草甸延伸，远山与积云映在湛蓝湖面上
新疆赛里木湖 (6).jpg.en: A lakeside highway curves past golden grasslands beneath distant mountains and cumulus clouds.

新疆赛里木湖 (7).jpg.zh: 阴云下，红边公路穿过黄绿草甸，弯向远湖与深色山脊
新疆赛里木湖 (7).jpg.en: Under heavy clouds, a red-edged road curves across tawny grassland toward a distant lake and dark ridges.

新疆赛里木湖.png.zh: 晴日高原湖泊上，三艘游船破开粼粼波光，远山横亘天际。
新疆赛里木湖.png.en: Three tour boats cross a glittering high-altitude lake beneath distant mountains on a clear day.

扎尕那.jpg.zh: 云雾压着锯齿峰顶，梯田间的白墙金顶寺院与藏寨
扎尕那.jpg.en: Cloud-wrapped jagged peaks above terraced fields, a white-walled monastery and Tibetan village

中卫 (1).jpg.zh: 低角度仰拍的沙丘波纹直抵脊线，人影与新月同框
中卫 (1).jpg.en: Low-angle view of rippled dunes, a tiny figure and crescent moon above the ridge

中卫 (2).jpg.zh: 银河横贯夜空，沙丘脊上脚印串串，远处地平线浮着橙红灯光。
中卫 (2).jpg.en: Footprints trail along a sand dune ridge beneath the Milky Way, distant city lights glowing on the horizon.

九寨沟 (1).jpg.zh: 冬季钙华瀑布，冰凌垂挂岩壁，丝绢水流跌落深蓝水潭
九寨沟 (1).jpg.en: Winter travertine cascades, icicles on rocks, silky water falling into a deep blue pool

连云港.jpg.zh: 日出时橙红霞光沿海平线铺开，礁石沉入深蓝静水
连云港.jpg.en: At sunrise, orange light spreads along the horizon; dark rocks sink into still blue water.

新疆赛里木湖 (3).jpg.zh: 暮色中银色SUV停在红黑公路，草原、湖面与远山泛着紫蓝
新疆赛里木湖 (3).jpg.en: At dusk, a silver SUV parked on a red-and-black road, grassland, lake and mountains in purple-blue.

新疆赛里木湖 (5).jpg.zh: 晴空下湛蓝湖岸，红路上一辆黑色SUV与举气球的女子
新疆赛里木湖 (5).jpg.en: Under clear skies, a black SUV on a red lakeside road, a woman raising balloons on the grass
